subject.title: feat(cli): improve editor handoffs for agents and humans

question: Should `crabbox/editor-handoff/v1` be accepted as a supported stable automation contract for `crabbox open`, including its lease-lifecycle and release-routing fields?
rationale: A versioned JSON CLI interface creates an ongoing compatibility promise that tests alone cannot define; maintainers need to choose the intended support boundary before it lands.

options.title: Adopt the v1 contract
options.body: Accept the current versioned JSON handoff as supported CLI API once redacted live terminal proof confirms the documented lifecycle behavior.

options.title: Keep output human-only
options.body: Decline the stable JSON API for now and retain the existing editor handoff until an automation-contract policy is defined.

options.title: Narrow the contract first
options.body: Request a smaller explicitly supported object that omits lifecycle or routing fields whose compatibility guarantees are not intended.

recommendation.title: Adopt the v1 contract
recommendation.body: Accept the current versioned JSON handoff as supported CLI API once redacted live terminal proof confirms the documented lifecycle behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the merged editor-handoff abstraction and authored the branch fixes that define its current lifecycle and release-routing behavior.
